senses.gloss: sure or definite; having no doubt

translations.th_TH: แน่นอน; มั่นใจ

definition_translations.zh_TW: 確定或肯定；沒有疑問的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 確かで明確な；疑いのない
definition_translations.vi_VN: chắc chắn hoặc rõ ràng; không nghi ngờ
definition_translations.th_TH: แน่ใจหรือชัดเจน ไม่มีข้อสงสัย

senses.gloss: particular but not specifically named or described
senses.example: Certain documents must be submitted before the deadline.

example_translations.zh_TW: 某些文件必須在截止日期前提交。
example_translations.ja_JP: 一定の書類は期限前に提出しなければならない。
example_translations.ko_KR: 특정 서류는 마감일 전에 제출해야 한다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Một số tài liệu nhất định phải được nộp trước hạn chót.
example_translations.th_TH: เอกสารบางรายการต้องส่งก่อนกำหนด

definition_translations.zh_TW: 特定但未具體命名或描述的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 特定だが具体的に名指しや説明されていない
